ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central regions of both lobes versus 25% low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edges, tips, and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white regions are contiguous and dominant. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a defined perimeter along the trailing edge and tips. Focal black mottling is present at the base where the fluke meets the water, with specific dark spots on the mid-left lobe and vertical rake marks on the inner-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular serrations with two prominent indentations. The right lobe trailing edge presents a smoother, lower-amplitude topography with micro-oscillations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The sweep follows a sigmoidal curve, displaying concavity near the median notch and transitioning to a convex trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, textured, circular white and yellowish nodes (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately five parallel, dark, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the inner-right ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both tips; significant irregular tissue notching on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible linear rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish/tan biological discoloration integrated with the barnacle clusters at the lobe tips.
